title: Hostile audit of a sealed finite-time RPCD route
objective: Compare every completed T143 sealed rollout using its immutable card and validated result, select one candidate by an explicit target-fidelity/falsifiability rule, then restate enough of it to attack its first implication edge and transfer to C050. This audit-local reconstruction is E4 hostile-audit work, not the fresh E5 independent reconstruction assigned to T145.
acceptance_checks: Reads every result from one complete validated T143 fanout and records the selected rollout_id, run_id, route-card hash, selection scores, rejected alternatives, and tie rule in candidate_selection.json.

Writes reconstruction_seed.json as a proof-free frozen package containing only the selected local lemma, assumptions, definitions, exact claimed C050 implication, source hashes, and unresolved-objection identifiers; it must contain no derivation, repair hint, or audit verdict.
Rebuilds enough of the candidate representation and core lemma from its statement to mount an independent attack without copying the explorer's derivation or implementation.

Labels statement_reconstruction.md as an audit-local attack artifact: it must not close or claim the independent_reconstruction gate, which requires the separate T145 run and a worker distinct from this auditor.
Identifies and attacks the first unproved implication edge rather than only checking downstream algebra.
Checks unit-diagonal normalization, fresh-epoch independence, every-initial-point quantifiers, finite-time prefactors, and expectation of distance rather than distance of expectation.
Selects at least two representation-appropriate analytic barriers from the RPCD failure map, including a near-singular noncommuting family.
Rejects any proof that silently assumes C051 or a stronger fixed-metric one-step certificate unless that claim is separately proved.
Uses an independent exact, formal, or certified control for any refutation; a numerical null search is not a PASS.
Records all surviving objections and does not promote beyond E4.

denylist: the T143 worker's private conversation or hidden reasoning
the T143 candidate's implementation except as an object under attack

required_differences: Restate the selected route in a fresh notation or equivalent representation solely to expose an attack surface.
Use controls not copied from the candidate verifier.
Audit the C050 transfer without assuming C051.
forbidden_methods: accepting the candidate's own tests as independent evidence
promoting a numerical null search to a theorem
changing the candidate statement after finding a counterexample
required_controls: permutation direction and transpose convention when applicable
full-state versus reachable-state distinction when applicable
dimension growth of every transient or norm-comparison constant
